issues.description: VIM for tip endothelial cells was included on the basis of the author's description that the non-sinusoidal cluster expressed high levels of VIM and CD34; it is a broad-expression gene but explicitly used in cluster annotation.
CD45RA and CD45 both normalize to PTPRC in this output; CD45RA is a protein isoform rather than a distinct gene, so the isoform distinction is not retained.
CXCL12+ cells (candidate 14) were judged context_only because CXCL12 appears only as an immunofluorescence co-localization descriptor, not as a formal annotated cell-type marker.
